decisions.rationale: Shaggy dark feral goat with long swept horns in a side view: all four legs stand apart under the coat (b and c hang the hair lower and nearly join the legs), the horns are thick enough for TRELLIS to keep solid, and its dark, ragged coat suits the Frostspine and Crownlands crags.

Feral goat from TRELLIS raw a-s7202 (a-s7201 rejected: right foreleg tucked under the chest), cooked with cook_quadruped.py: 5,898 triangles in one skinned mesh on the 31-joint quadruped rig, horns bound rigidly to the head; 1.55 m to the horn tops (about 1.15 m at the withers); 512 px maps baked at 1024; 422,728 bytes. Five clips: Idle, Graze, Walk at 1.0 m/s, Run at 4.6 m/s and Startle. r1 rejected: tone gamma 0.8 washed out the dark coat; r2 rejected: its Graze lowered the head past vertical and swung the swept-back horns forward over the face; r3 browses at knee height with the horns clear. Reviewed as a sheet of all five clips and beside the soldier in game.
limitations: Single-view TRELLIS reconstruction: the far flank and the underside are TRELLIS's invention.
Graze is a knee-high browse, not grazing at the ground: lowering the head further hooks the horns forward.

The raw's shaggy coat leaves 10 open boundary edges and 20 non-manifold edges after cleanup; 797 of 2,928 vertices take inverse-distance fallback weights within their body region (no tearing seen in the clip sheet).
Clips are procedural (IK gaits, oscillators), not motion capture; 512 px coat detail softens at the closest camera.
TRELLIS-derived: research and evaluation licence terms, no commercial clearance.

decisions.rationale: Bands of 4-7 goats browse at the feet of crags (homes within 22 m of a crag's talus) in the Frostspine, Crownlands and Ash Steppe (6 ranges); they startle at 11 m from the hero and scramble 24 m clear. Dark and compact against the scree, about waist high to the soldier; presentation only, so saves, collision and gameplay are unchanged.
limitations: Goats stay on the flat ground at the crag foot: the crags are blockers, not climbable terrain.
No blending between grazing and walking.
